author: ruisb
quote: After more than a decade of hype and a massive price tag, Grand Theft Auto VI feels like a major letdown compared to what was promised. Behind the giant map of Leonida and high-budget presentation are sluggish performance, frustrating bugs, and pacing that drags far too **** consoles, a 30 FPS cap and frame drops,make fast-paced action feel rougher than it should in a modern release. Early launch bugs, geometry glitches, and occasional crashes break immersion right when the game tries to feel most lifelike. The story with Jason and Lucia also leans heavily into relationship drama and slower, more restrictive stretches that can feel tedious rather than exciting. Once you push past the initial spectacle, too much of the experience relies on long stretches of downtime and rigid mission design instead of genuine freedom. Between the steep cost of entry and the rough edges at launch, it falls well short of the masterpiece many made it out to be..
